title: Agentics Omega shadow ledger
description: Display payload for https://webetsocial.com/agentics. The read-only function agentics-ledger reads Netlify Blobs store `agentics`, key `omega-shadow/latest.json`, and returns this document. If the key is missing it returns an empty document (empty: true) instead. Publish with the Netlify CLI (verified: blobs:set arguments are store, key, and optional value; --input reads the value from a file): netlify blobs:set agentics omega-shadow/latest.json --input <file>. A filled example is docs/agentics-dashboard-sample.json. Display only. This document does not place orders and does not change Omega picks.

ok.description: False when the stored object could not be read as a ledger. The empty missing-key document uses true.

empty.description: True only for the synthesized document returned when the blob key is missing or unusable. Omit or false for a published ledger.

mode.description: Default execution mode for the ledger. Each position may override it with its own status.

bankroll.description: Reference bankroll in USD. Drawdown percents are measured against this bankroll.

sample.description: True on the checked-in example. The page shows a sample banner and does not treat it as a live record.

daysElapsed.description: Calendar days elapsed since startedOn, America/New_York, inclusive of the start date when a position exists that day.

trades.description: Positions counted toward the gate, including open positions.

pl.description: Settled profit/loss in USD after fees. Sum of settled position pl.

roiPct.description: ROI in percent points, not a fraction. 4.2 means +4.2%. Defined as 100 * pl / staked, where staked is settled stake only.

staked.description: Sum of stake (USD, before fee) on settled positions. Open positions are excluded from ROI.

dailyPct.description: Max drawdown today, in percent points of bankroll.

weeklyPct.description: Max drawdown over the trailing 7 America/New_York days, in percent points of bankroll.

totalPct.description: Max drawdown since the gate started, in percent points of bankroll.

withinLimits.description: True when dailyPct <= 5, weeklyPct <= 7.5, and totalPct <= 12.

clv.description: Closing-line value versus the Polymarket close. Positive cents mean the close price was higher than the entry price.

date.description: America/New_York date of the featured daily CLV row. Null when no close has been recorded.

picks.description: Today's Omega picks that matched a Polymarket market. Unmatched picks are omitted.

ledger.description: Running ledger, newest first. Includes open and settled positions.

pick.description: Omega side that was matched. Example: Dodgers ML.

marketUrl.description: Optional https URL of the Polymarket market. The page ignores non-https URLs.

price.description: Entry price as a probability from 0 to 1. 0.57 displays as 57¢. Not American odds.

closePrice.description: Polymarket close price as a probability from 0 to 1. Null before the close is known.

fee.description: USD fee on the position. Not included in stake.

stake.description: USD paid for the position, before fee.

status.description: shadow: logged only. paper: simulated fill, no live order.

pl.description: USD profit/loss after fee. Null while open. Win: stake * (1 - price) / price - fee. Loss: -(stake + fee). Push or void: 0, or fee only if the fee was kept.

clvCents.description: (closePrice - price) * 100. Positive means the Polymarket close was above the entry price.
